title: Don’t Change My View: Ideological Bias Auditing in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes a primary experimental section focused on 'Religiously Motivated Manipulations' (Section 4.1). It utilizes a curated list of twenty religious worldviews (Table 3) and specific religious prompt templates (Table 5) to test its auditing framework. Additionally, it features a case study involving steering a model toward a conservative Christian worldview (Section 4.3).
